name: czl-ashare-screener
description: A-share screening workbench: compiles natural-language requests into a reviewable condition contract, fetches per-ticker data, scores five weighted dimensions with a deterministic engine, applies a hard risk gate, and returns a timestamped observation list with a screening funnel.

displayDescription.en: Compiles natural-language screening requests into a reviewable condition contract, fetches per-ticker data, scores five dimensions with a deterministic engine, applies a hard risk gate, and returns a timestamped observation list with a transparent screening funnel.
displayDescription.zh: 把自然语言选股需求编译成可复核的条件合约，逐票取数、五维打分、过风险闸门，输出带数据时点的观察清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我关注半导体，市值100亿以上，ROE大于8%，近5日主力资金净流入为正。先给我条件合约，再按五维打分出一张观察清单。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Semiconductors, market cap above CNY 10bn, ROE above 8%, positive net main-fund inflow over the last 5 sessions. Build the condition contract first, then score five dimensions and give me an observation list.

quickPrompts.zh: 我关注半导体，市值100亿以上，ROE大于8%，近5日主力资金净流入为正。先给我条件合约，再按五维打分出一张观察清单。
quickPrompts.en: Semiconductors, market cap above CNY 10bn, ROE above 8%, positive net main-fund inflow over the last 5 sessions. Build the condition contract first, then score five dimensions and give me an observation list.

quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有一批候选股的数据，等下贴给你。请按同一套标准打分排序，并告诉我哪几只卡在风险闸门上。
quickPrompts.en: I have data for a batch of candidates and will paste it. Score and rank them with one consistent standard, and tell me which ones fail the risk gate.

quickPrompts.zh: 想找低位放量突破的票，排除ST和连续涨停，不要给我已经涨到天上的。
quickPrompts.en: Looking for low-position breakouts on expanding volume, excluding ST names and multi-day limit-up streaks, and nothing that has already run up too far.
